name: factory-panel
description: Panes beside the chat for running an Agent IX factory: machines, focuses, an escalations inbox, ix-relay announcements, and team health.

prometheusUrl.description: Prometheus the panes query. Leave empty to use the shared ix config (observability.prometheusUrl), else this host's relay endpoint, else http://prometheus.luna.ix
prometheusUrl.title: Prometheus URL

grafanaUrl.description: Grafana, for the panes' dashboard links. Leave empty to use ix config observability.grafanaUrl, else derived from Prometheus's address
grafanaUrl.title: Grafana URL

teams.description: The teams ix-board may be asked about when nothing selects any (herdr workspace labels). /factory teams and a skill's declaration take precedence
teams.title: ix-board teams

refreshSeconds.description: How often Prometheus is polled while a view that draws it is on screen
refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)

openOnStart.description: Open the panes beside the chat when a fullscreen session starts. Off leaves them to /factory
openOnStart.title: Open panes at startup

inlineView.description: What a classic-layout session shows above the prompt: band, status or off
inlineView.title: Non-fullscreen view
